comparison_scope: The three routes are separate actions and their Hessian entries are never added.
Strengths 1000 and 10000 are dimensionless controls, not physical fits.

Current Hessian rows show the uniform-radius and shared-q plane; pointwise coefficients test bare spinor positivity for all smooth conformal directions, and depth-two form rows include nine zonal directions.
The listed current a*v^2 values are lower bounds from finite tested metric subspaces, not sufficient thresholds for all metric perturbations.
The background potential, local causal completion, tensor metric response, complete wave stability, and exact finite-strength mass law remain unproved.
